name: openai-compatible
summary: A hosted OpenAI-compatible LLM (OpenRouter by default; Together or any host that follows the OpenAI layout), reached over https with your API key: chat completions and a model list

connect.description: A hosted OpenAI-compatible LLM over https (bearer key)

notes: Put your key in the store yourself, in your own terminal (never in Claude): lotr secret put llm-api-key. Register with: lotr add-http NAME@zone --from-template openai-compatible [--token-ref store:YOUR-NAME].

Another host: pass its base URL without the /v1 part, for example --base-url https://api.together.xyz. The operations are POST /v1/chat/completions and GET /v1/models on every host that follows the OpenAI layout; a host with a different prefix (Groq serves under /openai) is not covered by this template.

The farm names the host in its service-table row: set the row's provider column (for example openrouter). This template names no provider on purpose, so one template serves every host; the farm lets the row name it only when the connection does not.

Whatever you send leaves this machine. The farm's own gate keeps private packets off a remote engine, but the host's retention and training policy is an account setting on the host (for OpenRouter: the privacy settings and a per-key credit limit), not something gt controls. Check them before you send anything that is not public.
The model cannot act: llm.tools is none, so the farm may send to it. Do not put a tool-calling agent behind this connection without raising that value.

A provider's answers come back as structured codes: 429 is upstream_rate_limited (with its Retry-After), 402 (out of credit) is upstream_payment_required, 5xx is upstream_error, a bad key stays http_401. lotr status --check sends GET /v1/models WITHOUT your key (the probe never carries a credential), so it shows that the host answers, not that the key works: a wrong key shows on the first call as http_401. If your host requires a key even for the model list, status will show an error while calls still work.
